text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Fees (Corrupt Practices Investigation Bureau) Order.

2. The following fees shall be leviable for such copies of reports, documents, statements, plans and photographs as the Director, Corrupt Practices Investigation Bureau may permit to be supplied to the public:
(a)copy of a report or document
$16
(b)copy of a statement recorded from an accused person in accordance with section 122 of the Criminal Procedure Code (Cap. 68)
$16
(c)copy of plan
$77
(d)copy of photograph:
(i)20.3 cm x 25.4 cm (black and white)
$43
(ii)18 cm x 12.7 cm (colour)
$47.

3. A fee of $14 shall be leviable by the Director, Corrupt Practices Investigation Bureau for every search for any report, document, statement, information or record in the possession of the Corrupt Practices Investigation Bureau.
[G.N. Nos. S 373/93; S 4/95; S 479/95; S 526/2004]
